value.rationale: Answers the natural joint-independence question connecting classical modular Stern/Calkin–Wilf residues with a binary-digit-weight (Thue–Morse-type) arithmetic observable. The braid identity gives a structural reason for full support for every pair of fixed moduli, and the error has a qualitative power saving; neither a routine marginal restatement nor an arbitrary finite table.
